name: gauge-arm
title: Lever bench: gauge arm
description: Bolts on top of the rig's wall and reaches over the load bolt, holding a dial indicator's 8 mm stem in a clamped bore so its plunger rests on the load bolt's head.
orientation: Flat on the bed, as it sits on the wall. Two M5 × 35 into the wall's slotted nuts; an M4 × 40 across the clamp, its nut in the back pocket. Tighten the clamp just enough to hold the stem.

nut4.rule: M4 nut pocket, across the flats

bore.rule: The indicator's stem, a close fit before clamping

left.rule: The arm's left end, flush with the wall's

front.rule: The arm's front face: it reaches out over the specimen

gauge_y.rule: Over the middle of the load bolt's head: past the specimen and the hanger

slit.rule: The clamp's slit, from the bore to the end

pinch_x.rule: The clamp bolt, across the slit between the bore and the end

through.rule: A hole's cutter length: further than the arm is wide
